snippet.title: Over Engineered - Announcement Trailer | Coming to Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Over Engineered on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706500/Over_Engineered/ 
Guide a ball through hand-crafted puzzles using a fixed set of parts. Inspired by Rube Goldberg machines, you’ll soon craft sprawling machines where complexity is your goal. Get ready to overtake your screen with over-engineered chaos.
Free demo available during Steam Next Fest — Wishlist now to get notified.

#steam #indiegames #nextfest #rubegoldbergmachine #rubegoldberg
